headline: You’re seeing a repeatable pattern in trade sizing.

size_up_after_loss.why_it_matters: The pattern cost you ₹1,05,732, coming from 96 after‑loss trades where the median entry size was ₹12,562 compared with your usual ₹6,578. Your entry size after a loss was about 1.91x larger, leading to a loss of ₹1,95,375 and a win rate of 28% versus a 39% win rate on other trades.
size_up_after_loss.rule: After a loss, your next entry is your usual size.

averaging_down.note: Adding to losing positions is starting to show up, so keep an eye on it.

closing: Consider applying the rule about entry size after a loss next month.
